verdict.rationale: The NVIDIA B200 / DGX B200 is physical GPU hardware that the customer installs in its own data center, not a hosted service with selectable storage regions. Choosing a data region or residency is a cloud-service axis and a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows NVIDIA offering a region or residency selection feature for B200; the air-gapped deployment mention belongs to NIM, a separate product, and is not credited here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
